name: SLIME
hint: Return the solid ball. Angle shots with the paddle tip.

name: SKELETON
hint: A shield grows every third return. Aim around it.

name: WRAITH
hint: Only the solid white ball is real.

name: NECROMANCER
hint: Outlined bone walls break when the ball hits them.

name: BONE KING
hint: Break the guard. Gold diamonds can be blocked.

name: THE MASON
hint: Bank around the moving central wall.

name: HUNTER
hint: Dodge filled red diamonds. The white ball still matters.

name: TWINS
hint: Two solid balls. Incoming shots arrive in a shared lane.

name: GATEKEEPER
hint: Purple gates wrap the ball from top to bottom.

name: PHANTOM QUEEN
hint: Watch the solid ball; outlined echoes cannot hurt you.

name: CHORISTER
hint: Dashed red lanes warn where the next wave will travel.

name: FALLEN STAR
hint: Gravity bends the ball. Aim a little higher.

name: THE SWARM
hint: Hit each small paddle to destroy it.

name: LAST VIGIL
hint: Survive 35 seconds. Return the ball from the far wall.

name: BULLET SAINT
hint: Dodge the lanes. Bank the white ball into the open core.

name: THE PRESS
hint: The walls close slowly. The dashed boundary is the limit.

name: THE VAULT
hint: Destroy the four blocks before the enemy can take damage.

name: TWIN GATES
hint: Two balls and paired gates. Watch their travel direction.

name: THE REFLECTION
hint: You are the RIGHT paddle. The controls stay the same.

name: THE ARCHITECT
hint: A duel becomes many rules. The last rally decides it.
